name: Winline
note: Russian bookmaker operating as Winline. Belongs to a group of founders; Legalbet names Dmitry Myslivtsev as main owner and founder (other betting outlets say the largest stake of about 45% belongs to Andrey Myslivtsev). stavka.tv's founder table for the legal entity LLC "Upravlyayushchaya kompaniya NKS" lists Andrey Myslivtsev 45%, Larisa Egorchenko 20%, Robert Yusupov 16%, Eduard Grishkin 15%, Lyalya Yusupova 4% (CEO Georgy Nalivkin); the first-name conflict with Legalbet stays documented. Title partner of FC Krasnodar since 2020, the agreement running to the end of the 2026/27 season (sports.ru, 10 Jul 2025); also a Zenit partner and a partner of KHL club Avtomobilist (Legalbet).
